verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an official MCP integration that lets MCP-compatible agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use it directly as a web search tool, backed by an official serpapi-mcp repo. It also offers an LLM-optimized markdown output mode and agent-oriented docs (llms.txt, .md pages), so the core story of dropping the API into an agent as a ready-made tool is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit function-calling/tool schemas (the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404), documented native integrations with agent frameworks beyond MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.
